meta-runner.name: Dynamic Build Chain Settings Generator
meta-runner.description:
A two-step recipe that can be used to dynamically generate settings for a build chain.
This recipe executes the generation step and publishes the settings as an artifact.
This recipe prepares an environment so that the DSL runs as if it were generating settings within the context of your project. To do so, it needs credentials with EDIT permissions to the project. These credentials should be provided as `agent_username` and `agent_password`.

parameters.param:
cd .teamcity/
curl -sSf -u "%agent_username%:%agent_password%" -o dsl-context.zip "%DSL_CONTEXT_URL%"
JAVA_HOME=~/.asdf/installs/java/corretto-21.0.11.10.1 mvn -Dteamcity.versionedSettings.exposeInternalParameters=true -Dteamcity.internal.dsl.IS_DYNAMIC_CHAIN=true -DserverContext=dsl-context.zip teamcity-configs:generate -f pom.xml
rm -rf "target/generated-configs/%DSL_RELATIVE_ROOT_ID%"
